_raSoatSkill4d.2_trangThaiNhanVat: Hai co gai o 3 moc: 1917 (C1-02, C1-03), 1920 (C1-41, C1-42), gia (C1-68, C1-70) — moi moc mot asset rieng (skill 5b, doi tuoi + trang phuc). 'Frances died in 1986 / Elsie died in 1988' KHONG ve canh chet: dung lai chan dung gia, nam la chu hau ky.
_raSoatSkill4d.3_nguoiCoThatDuocGoiTen: Elsie Wright, Frances Griffiths (anh that: 5 tam anh tien + anh chung), Arthur Conan Doyle (anh ~1920), Edward Gardner (anh chan dung). KHONG co chan dung: Arthur Wright, Polly Wright, Harold Snelling, va hai chi em luc gia (1966-1983) — ha xuong `figure`, ta theo trang phuc dung thoi ky, ghi HU CAU trong note (SPEC-v2 muc 4c). Nguoi khong ten: dien gia buoi giang 1919, nha ngoai cam 1921 (co that la Geoffrey Hodson, loi ke khong goi ten), phong vien 1966, nguoi hoai nghi 1978, chuyen gia anh 1982 (co that la Geoffrey Crawley, loi ke khong goi ten).
_raSoatSkill4d.4_tenSaiThoiKy: Khong co ten doi theo thoi ky. 'The Strand' va 'Kodak' la ten dung nam 1920. Cape Town, Melbourne khong doi ten.
_raSoatSkill4d.5_trangThaiGoc: Hinh co gai mua trong sach (C1-77) -> hinh tien ve lai (C1-76) -> hinh cat ra (C1-78b) -> cam bang kim trong co (C1-78c) -> vut xuong suoi (C1-78e). Tam kinh trong khay (C1-14) -> anh hien ra (C1-14b).
_raSoatSkill4d.6_choNoi: Kim cai mu xuyen qua hinh giay cam xuong dat (C1-78c) — cho noi la chu the cua anh.
_raSoatSkill4d.7_nhayCoc: Them C1-12 (hai co gai mang may xuong suoi) va C1-12b (tra may cho cha) — loi ke xac nhan ca hai. KHONG them canh hai co gai dung hinh giay de chup o 1917 truoc khi loi ke tiet lo: se lo loi giai som. Canh 'chup anh' chi co o C1-78 sau loi thu nhan.
_raSoatSkill4d.8_hanhViNoi: Nguoi lon hoi (C1-07b: nguoi noi la me, nguoi nghe la hai co gai). Hai co gai tra loi (C1-08). Cha noi 'bia giay' (C1-18), cha tu choi (C1-21). Snelling tuyen bo (C1-33). Hai co gai giai thich voi Gardner (C1-42b). Nha ngoai cam noi thay tien (C1-62: ve HANH VI NOI, khong ve tien). Elsie gia tra loi phong vien (C1-68b). Hai ba thu nhan voi nguoi phong van (C1-75b). Elsie giai thich (C1-84). Frances khang dinh (C1-89).
_raSoatSkill4d.9_mucChacChan: C1-62 khong ve tien quanh nha ngoai cam (chi la loi anh ta noi). C1-89 va cau S90 (loi ke cua Frances ve chieu thu Bay mua) KHONG ve tien hien dan trong co — dung lai anh Frances gia dang noi. C1-30: ve Gardner cam tam kinh, khong ve 'tien hien ra'. Cau 'double exposure' la GIA THUYET cua chuyen gia — dung lai anh chuyen gia C1-72b, khong ve so do chup chong.
_raSoatSkill4d.10_trungChucNang_dungLai: Xem _dungLai (41 cau dung lai anh san co). BO vi trung chuc nang: canh 'sold out' (trung tap chi C1-53, chu hau ky), co nuoc Anh (trung ban do C1-01 — 'north of England' la dia ly, khong phai quoc gia hanh dong), bang/co Nam Phi 1917 (trung ban do C1-04), hai phu nu truong thanh 'grew up, got married' (khong co tu lieu, chu hau ky), so do chup chong (gia thuyet). BO vi gioi han Dan dung: co gai nhin tien hien ra trong co (S90), hai co gai 'played along' (S64, loi ke ve sau), cao be Doyle vui mung doc dien tin.
_raSoatSkill4d.11_netMat: Net mat trung tinh mac dinh. GIU nu cuoi o C1-12b (loi ke 'looking triumphant'). Cac shot khac khong gan tam trang.

_thuNghiem: Shot mention dua NGUOI MOI vao cau co goi ten anh neo (skill 4d-9d, CHUA DO): C1-26b, C1-28, C1-29, C1-34, C1-62, C1-68b, C1-70b, C1-72, C1-72b, C1-75b. Shot ve lai anh tien (C1-14b, C1-20, C1-46, C1-47): cau styleByKind 'Only one person in the image' noi vao cuoi — prompt noi ro tien KHONG phai nguoi; soi xem model co xoa tien khong.
_anhChung: Mọi ảnh vẽ theo nét của ba ảnh neo phong cách Tú gửi — viền mực đen dày không đều, tô màu phẳng, gạch chì thấy nét, nền trắng trơn — khổ 16:9. Người có MẶT ĐƠN GIẢN: mắt chấm nhỏ, mũi ngắn, miệng một nét (hoặc hình mở khi đang nói/cười), không đổ bóng trên mặt. Shot vẽ bằng CHỮ thì runner tự đính một ảnh neo theo loại (một người → 02, nhóm → 03, đồ vật/nơi chốn → 01). Shot @MENTION chỉ dùng ảnh được gọi tên trong câu. NĂM TẤM ẢNH TIÊN GỐC là hiện vật thật: lúc dựng có thể chèn thẳng ảnh thật (refs/case-1/01-fairy-photos-*) cạnh bản vẽ lại C1-14b, C1-20, C1-46, C1-47, C1-48 — Tú chọn.

_dungLai.at: In the summer of 1917, in Cottingley, a small village just outside the city of Bradford in the north of England, two cousins kept getting into trouble for the very same thing.
_dungLai.cue: two cousins kept getting into trouble
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai co gai o suoi — dung chinh viec gay rac roi.

_dungLai.at: Nobody believed them.
_dungLai.lyDo: Me dang hoi, hai con dung nghe.

_dungLai.at: Right in front of her face, 4 tiny winged figures were dancing.
_dungLai.lyDo: Cung khung voi cau truoc; con so 4 la chu hau ky neu can.

_dungLai.at: Arthur didn't believe it for a second.
_dungLai.cue: Arthur didn't believe it for a second
_dungLai.lyDo: Cha trong buong toi, net mat trung tinh.

_dungLai.at: About 2 months later, the girls borrowed the camera again and came back with a second picture.
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai co gai mang may di.

_dungLai.at: It was funny, she wrote, that she had never seen the fairies in Africa.
_dungLai.cue: never seen the fairies in Africa
_dungLai.lyDo: Frances viet thu + ban do Nam Phi. KHONG ve noi dung thu.

_dungLai.at: It must have been too hot for them there.
_dungLai.lyDo: Noi dung thu la chu hau ky.

_dungLai.at: Near the end of 1918, Frances wrote to an old friend back in Cape Town.
_dungLai.lyDo: Ban do Nam Phi co CAPE TOWN.

_dungLai.at: The topic that evening was the life of fairies.
_dungLai.lyDo: Buoi giang; de tai la chu hau ky.

_dungLai.at: Kodak couldn't find any sign of faking either, but it refused to certify that they were real pictures of fairies.
_dungLai.cue: Kodak couldn't find any sign of faking
_dungLai.lyDo: Logo Kodak THAT la hau ky (bang 4c: logo that), khong ve.

_dungLai.at: In real life, Doyle was a committed spiritualist.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chan dung Doyle. Khong ve canh gop hon (khong co nguon canh cu the).

_dungLai.at: That day, and again 2 days later, they took 3 more photographs.
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai co gai cam may; so 3 la chu hau ky.

_dungLai.at: And the fifth photograph has no girls in it at all.
_dungLai.cue: the fifth photograph has no girls
_dungLai.lyDo: Anh tien tam nang.

_dungLai.at: It became known as "Fairies and Their Sun-Bath."
_dungLai.lyDo: Ten anh la chu hau ky.

_dungLai.at: The issue sold out within days.
_dungLai.cue: The issue sold out within days
_dungLai.lyDo: Tap chi mo; 'ban het' la chu hau ky.

_dungLai.at: The girls' real names were kept out of print, and they appeared as "Alice" and "Iris."
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai chan dung 1917 + chu ten gia o hau ky.

_dungLai.at: One paper remarked dryly that what this story needed wasn't an understanding of the occult but an understanding of children.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chong bao.

_dungLai.at: But Doyle didn't back down.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chan dung Doyle.

_dungLai.at: The girls saw nothing, and not a single new photograph was taken.
_dungLai.cue: not a single new photograph was taken
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai co gai cam may + dau X hau ky.

_dungLai.at: Years later, the cousins admitted they had simply played along with him for fun.
_dungLai.cue: played along with him for fun
_dungLai.lyDo: Khong ve 'hua theo cho vui' (loi ke ve sau, khong co hinh thuc).

_dungLai.at: After that, the story slowly faded.
_dungLai.lyDo: Tap chi cu.

_dungLai.at: She said the fairies might have been figments of her imagination, but she left open the possibility that she had somehow photographed her own thoughts.
_dungLai.lyDo: Elsie dang noi voi phong vien.

_dungLai.at: But they still wouldn't admit to faking anything.
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai ba tren truyen hinh.

_dungLai.at: They all came to the same conclusion.
_dungLai.cue: They all came to the same conclusion
_dungLai.lyDo: Chuyen gia soi anh.

_dungLai.at: The pictures were fake.
_dungLai.lyDo: Anh tien + dau X do hau ky.

_dungLai.at: Arthur Wright had guessed right on that very first night in his darkroom.
_dungLai.cue: guessed right on that very first night
_dungLai.lyDo: Cha trong buong toi — cap dau cuoi voi C1-13.

_dungLai.at: And Harold Snelling hadn't been wrong either.
_dungLai.lyDo: Snelling soi tam kinh.

_dungLai.at: The plates had never been tampered with.
_dungLai.lyDo: Tam kinh trong khay.

_dungLai.at: It just happened to be made of paper.
_dungLai.cue: happened to be made of paper
_dungLai.lyDo: Hinh giay cam kim — cap dau cuoi voi C1-14b.

_dungLai.at: They were just 2 village kids, she said, and up against a brilliant man like Conan Doyle, all they could do was keep quiet.
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai co gai 1917 + Doyle.

_dungLai.at: Elsie said all 5 were fakes.
_dungLai.lyDo: Elsie gia dang noi.

_dungLai.at: She said it was a wet Saturday afternoon, Elsie had nothing prepared, and Frances saw the fairies slowly taking shape in the grass, so she simply raised the camera and took the picture.
_dungLai.lyDo: LOI KE cua Frances — khong ve tien hien ra (cau ra 9).

_dungLai.at: One photography expert suggested it might have been an accidental double exposure, made while some of the paper fairies were still lying in the grass.
_dungLai.lyDo: Cung chuyen gia (Crawley). Gia thuyet — khong ve so do.

_dungLai.at: If so, both women could have been telling the truth as they saw it.
_dungLai.cue: telling the truth as they saw it
_dungLai.lyDo: Hai ba ngoi canh nhau.

_dungLai.at: Frances died in 1986.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chan dung Frances gia; nam la chu hau ky. Khong ve cai chet.

_dungLai.at: Elsie died in 1988.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chan dung Elsie gia.

_dungLai.at: Neither of them ever changed her story about that last photograph.
_dungLai.cue: changed her story about that last photograph
_dungLai.lyDo: Anh tien tam nang — nhip cuoi.

_dungLai.at: The girls grew up, got married, and spent years living abroad.
_dungLai.cue: got married, and spent years living abroad
_dungLai.lyDo: Chan dung hai chi em 1920; 'lay chong, song o nuoc ngoai' la chu hau ky (khong co tu lieu hinh).

_dungLai.at: But journalists never quite forgot them.
_dungLai.lyDo: Chong bao.

_dungLai.at: They showed exactly what had been in front of the camera.
_dungLai.cue: exactly what had been in front of the camera
_dungLai.lyDo: Anh tien dau tien — tra chi tiet dat truoc o C1-33 (loi Snelling).

_dungLai.at: But there was one photograph the cousins never agreed on.
_dungLai.cue: one photograph the cousins never agreed on
_dungLai.lyDo: Anh tam nang.

shots.anhSeRa: Ngôi nhà đầu dãy hai tầng nhìn thẳng mặt tiền, xây đá sa thạch khối thô màu vàng xám xếp hàng đều, tường hồi bên phải sẫm hơn. Mái ngói đá phiến xám dốc thấp, hàng con sơn đá nhỏ dưới máng xối; một ống khói đá cao vươn lên ở đầu hồi, một ống khói thấp có hàng chụp gốm ở chỗ giáp nhà bên. Mặt tiền: cửa gỗ sẫm có ô kính chữ nhật phía trên nằm bên trái; bên phải là một cửa sổ khung trượt ở tầng dưới và một cửa sổ y hệt thẳng phía trên ở tầng hai, lanh tô và bậu đá dày. shots.draw: A two-storey end-of-terrace house seen straight from the front, built of rough-faced honey-grey Yorkshire sandstone blocks in even courses, the side gable wall on the right darker and weathered. A low-pitched grey slate roof with a row of small square stone blocks under the gutter; a tall plain stone chimney stack rising from the gable end, and a shorter chimney stack with a row of clay chimney pots where the roof meets the next house. On the front: a plain dark wooden panelled door on the left with a small rectangular glass pane above it; to its right one sash window with two-over-two panes on the ground floor and a matching sash window directly above it on the first floor, each with a thick plain stone lintel and a stone sill. Only a narrow slice of the neighbouring house, in the same stone, shows at the left edge. A narrow front garden with a few shrubs and a climbing plant, behind a low stone wall. No people, no lettering, no house number, no sun.

shots.anhSeRa: Elsie và Frances 1917 (C1-02, C1-03) nguyên người đứng trên đá ở mép con suối C1-05, thả vài hình giấy nhỏ có cánh xuống dòng nước; các hình giấy trôi trên mặt nước. Không chữ.
shots.canSoi: Hình trôi phải đọc ra là giấy.
shots.mention: draw the same two girls as in {{Older Girl Ref Bell Hat White Dress}} and {{Young Girl Ref Flower Band Long Hair}}, keep both faces exactly the same, seen full length standing on the flat stones at the edge of the same stream as in {{Stream Ref Flat Stones Small Fall}}, in the same white dresses and boots, dropping a few small flat paper cut-out figures with wings into the water, where they float away on the current, the younger girl plainly shorter with her head only reaching the older girl's shoulder, no lettering, plain white background

daTao.ten: Two Girls Tossing Paper Figures Into Stream

shots.at: Elsie explained their long silence simply.
shots.cue: Elsie explained their long silence
shots.outName: Elderly Woman Speaking With Open Hands
shots.intent: Hanh vi noi cua Elsie gia — dung lai cho 'all 5 were fakes'
shots.tomTat: Elsie già đang nói, hai tay mở
shots.anhSeRa: Vẽ lại Elsie lúc già (C1-68, giữ nguyên mặt) nửa người đang nói, hai bàn tay mở ra trước ngực. Mặt trung tính. Chỉ một người.
shots.canSoi: Không thêm nét buồn/ăn năn.
shots.mention: draw the same elderly woman as in {{Elderly Woman Ref White Curls Cardigan}}, keep her face exactly the same, seen from the chest up talking with her mouth open and both hands open in front of her chest, in the same cardigan, no lettering, plain white background

daTao.ten: Elderly Woman Speaking With Open Hands

shots.at: Frances, in a letter written in 1983, said she had hated those photographs since she was 16 years old.
shots.cue: in a letter written in 1983
shots.outName: Old Lady Writing A Letter At Table
shots.intent: Frances gia viet thu — noi dung la chu hau ky. Cap voi C1-23 (Frances be viet thu 1918)
shots.tomTat: Frances già ngồi viết thư
shots.anhSeRa: Vẽ lại Frances lúc già (C1-70, giữ nguyên mặt) nửa người ngồi bên bàn viết thư bằng bút, tờ giấy chỉ có dòng kẻ xám. Chỉ một người. Không chữ.
shots.canSoi: Đặt cạnh C1-23 (cùng tư thế viết thư) — đọc ra cùng một người qua 65 năm.
shots.mention: draw the same elderly woman as in {{Old Lady Ref Grey Bob Green Jumper}}, keep her face exactly the same, seen from the chest up sitting at a table writing a letter with a pen, the paper showing only a few thin grey lines and no letters, in the same green jumper and pearls, no lettering, plain white background
shots.note: Skill 4b: dong dang voi C1-23 de hau ky cat canh nhau.

daTao.ten: Old Lady Writing A Letter At Table

shots.at: Frances insisted, for the rest of her life, that the fifth one, the sun bath, was real.
shots.cue: Frances insisted, for the rest of her life
shots.outName: Old Lady Speaking Holding One Photograph
shots.intent: Frances khang dinh anh thu nam la that (hanh vi noi) — dung lai cho loi ke 'wet Saturday'
shots.tomTat: Frances già cầm một tấm ảnh, đang nói
shots.anhSeRa: Vẽ lại Frances lúc già (C1-70, giữ nguyên mặt) nửa người, một tay cầm một tấm ảnh nhỏ nâu đỏ quay mặt sau ra người xem, đang nói. Mặt trung tính. Chỉ một người.
shots.canSoi: Tấm ảnh quay mặt sau — không vẽ tiên. Không thêm vẻ bướng/giận.

shots.note: Cau ra 9: 'insisted ... was real' la loi cua Frances — khong ve tien.
